plan.title: Plan locked the night before: the morning kickoff reminds and checks they're still in, not a first "You in?"

context.text: Honestly I can barely do 3 push-ups right now
Everyone starts somewhere, and 3 is a start. Is there something you're working toward with this?

transcript.text: I want to do 10 real push-ups in a row by Christmas. Every day except Sunday works

Ten real push-ups by Christmas, starting from 3, is a solid and doable target, Jordan. Here's the plan:

• Goal: 10 real push-ups in a row by Dec 25
• Setup today: pick a sturdy spot (counter or couch edge) for incline push-ups, and clear a patch of floor
• Day 1, tonight at 9 pm at home, 20 min: 2 min warm-up, 4 sets of 5 incline push-ups with 90 sec rest, then one all-out set of floor push-ups to find your starting number
• Usual schedule: 6:30 pm, 20 min, Monday to Saturday, Sunday off
• Proof: a photo of you in the push-up position on your setup. A voice note with your max count works too.
• Why: incline reps build the strength for floor reps, and tonight's max gives us a number to beat.

Each day's result shapes the next step, so we build toward 10 on the floor.

What do you think?
Love that, Jordan. Ten real push-ups by Christmas, Monday to Saturday, starting tonight at 9. Are you officially committing to this?
Yes, I'm committing to it. Let's start tomorrow
Locked in, Jordan! Day 1 is tomorrow, Tuesday, at 6:30 pm at home. Ten real push-ups by Christmas starts there 💪

Morning Jordan! Tonight is day 1 toward your 10 real push-ups by Christmas. You said yes, so it's 4 sets of 5 incline push-ups with a 2 min warm-up first, then one all-out floor set to find your starting number. Pick your counter or couch edge now so it's ready. Still in?

grade.summary: ZOH handled the plan, commitment and lock well, with a warm plan built from Jordan's own goal and a clean hype line once locked. The next-morning kickoff fixed the earlier 'You in?' problem with 'Still in?', but it ran too long and left out the 6:30 pm time and 20-minute length.
